info.bio:
Vampire Weekend es una banda de indie-rock con influencias africanas, originaria de Nueva York y fundada en febrero de 2006, que se hizo conocida por medio de varios blogs de Internet.

Sus miembros se conocieron en la universidad de Columbia, donde hicieron una película de la que eligieron el nombre de la banda: Vampire Weekend (en la canción Walcott hablan sobre ello).

En 2007, su hit Cape Cod Kwassa Kwassa terminó en la posición número 67 de la lista que expone cada año Rolling Stone "Las 100 mejores canciones del año".

podcast.title: Planned Woodstock 50 Performance
podcast.body: Vampire Weekend was among the 80 artists who initially committed to perform at the Woodstock 50 festival, an event planned for August 2019 to celebrate the 50th anniversary of Woodstock. The festival faced numerous problems and was eventually canceled before it could take place. "80 artists had originally signed up, including Santana, Dead & Company, The Killers, Jay-Z, Imagine Dragons, Cage the Elf and Miley Cyrus, Vampire Weekend, and more."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: The 100 Greatest Rock Moments of the Millennium So Far - Part 5: (60-51)

podcast.title: Rise Through Hipster Bloggers
podcast.body: Vampire Weekend serves as an example of a band that achieved rapid fame by gaining support from influential "hipster bloggers." This illustrates the significant power of independent online tastemakers in the digital age, enabling bands to reach a wide audience without traditional label support. "Just as bands like Ovenpire weekend."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: The History of Alt Rock Chapter: 15

podcast.title: Twilight Soundtracks Contribution
podcast.body: Vampire Weekend contributed to the various *Twilight* soundtracks that accompanied the film series. These soundtracks featured a nice selection of tunes, mostly album cuts and outtakes, from a range of artists spanning different genres. "The Paramore, Lincoln Park, Collective Soul, Death Cab for Cutie, Tom York, the Killers, Editors, Metric, Block Keys, Dead Weather, Beck, Vampire Weekend, Florence in the Machine."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Contemporaries in the Mid-2000s
xref.body: During their early and mid-2000s period, The Black Keys shared the scene with other notable indie bands such as Vampire Weekend, The National, Interpol, The Hold Steady, and Gaslight Anthem. "Their contemporaries at the time included Vampire Weekend, We Had The National, Interpol, The Hold Steady, and Gas Line Anthem."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Planned Woodstock 50 Performance
xref.body: Santana was among the 80 artists originally confirmed to perform at the Woodstock 50 festival, which was planned for August 2019 to commemorate the original event. However, the festival was ultimately canceled due to numerous logistical and financial issues. "80 artists had originally signed up, including Santana, Dead & Company, The Killers, Jay-Z, Imagine Dragons, Cage the Elf and Miley Cyrus, Vampire Weekend, and more."

xref.title: Planned Woodstock 50 Performance
xref.body: Dead & Company were listed as one of the 80 artists initially scheduled to perform at the ill-fated Woodstock 50 festival in August 2019. Their participation was part of the attempt to create a diverse and commemorative lineup for the 50th anniversary of the legendary event. "80 artists had originally signed up, including Santana, Dead & Company, The Killers, Jay-Z, Imagine Dragons, Cage the Elf and Miley Cyrus, Vampire Weekend, and more."

xref.title: Planned Woodstock 50 Performance
xref.body: Imagine Dragons were among the 80 artists who had signed up to perform at the Woodstock 50 festival, intended to mark the 50th anniversary of the iconic 1969 event in August 2019. The festival, however, never came to fruition. "80 artists had originally signed up, including Santana, Dead & Company, The Killers, Jay-Z, Imagine Dragons, Cage the Elf and Miley Cyrus, Vampire Weekend, and more."

xref.title: Planned Woodstock 50 Performance
xref.body: Cage the Elephant was part of the original lineup of 80 artists slated to perform at the Woodstock 50 festival in August 2019, which aimed to commemorate the 50th anniversary of the legendary Woodstock event. The festival was ultimately canceled due to a host of unresolved issues. "80 artists had originally signed up, including Santana, Dead & Company, The Killers, Jay-Z, Imagine Dragons, Cage the Elf and Miley Cyrus, Vampire Weekend, and more."

xref.title: Planned Woodstock 50 Performance
xref.body: Miley Cyrus was among the 80 artists originally confirmed to perform at the Woodstock 50 festival, planned for August 2019. Her inclusion was part of a diverse lineup intended to attract a wide audience for the 50th anniversary celebration, though the event was ultimately canceled. "80 artists had originally signed up, including Santana, Dead & Company, The Killers, Jay-Z, Imagine Dragons, Cage the Elf and Miley Cyrus, Vampire Weekend, and more."
